verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS scheduling platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers interfaces for external AI agents: a hosted MCP server, an agent-oriented API v2 and an official CLI. These let outside clients manage scheduling, but they are developer building blocks or adjacent capabilities, not an assistant built into Cal.com that a user can delegate tasks to. With no evidence of such an assistant, the verdict is none.
